prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1149; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with a complaint of left wrist pain and limited grip. Over three visits, the patient was evaluated, imaged, and managed for a distal radius fracture. Radiographs and the physical examination clearly confirmed the fracture, with localized swelling, tenderness over the distal radius, and reduced range of motion at the wrist. The injury pattern is consistent with the mechanism described, namely a fall onto an outstretched hand and forceful bracing against the vehicle interior during the impact. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this wrist or adjacent body region, and none appears in the available history. Care followed a typical course: immobilization, pain management, and a graded return to activity with hand therapy guidance. Symptoms and functional limitations steadily improved, and follow-up visits were tapered as healing progressed. Billed services corresponded to the visits documented, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified.
